question: How is the multitude of elements and the creation of objects understood to manifest?
premises: The multitude of elements shines forth.
It is illuminated and appears as the creation of objects.
This manifestation is described according to power by the speaker.
inference: The elemental host and objective creation manifest as an illuminated display understood in terms of power.
uncertainties: The scope of śaktito, whether divine power or cognitive capacity, is not fully specified.
plain_english: The multitude of elements shines forth, illuminated also as the creation of objects; thus it is understood by me according to power.
